_meta.purpose: Certification-scheme overlay. The scraped Task 1 dataset has no certification_type column, so every row would otherwise show 'None' and the certification badge feature would be dead. This file tags standards with the applicable BIS scheme and is applied on top of whatever dataset is loaded.
_meta.keys: Base IS number as a plain string ('269'), or 'base|part' for a specific part ('9873|1'). A 'base|part' entry wins over the bare base entry.

schemes.BIS Product Certification: ISI mark under Scheme-I of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018, usually made mandatory by a Quality Control Order (QCO).
schemes.CRS: Compulsory Registration Scheme (Scheme-II) for electronics and IT goods notified by MeitY.
schemes.Hallmarking: BIS hallmarking scheme for precious metal jewellery and artefacts.

_meta.confidence: 'high' = checked against a bis.gov.in document during curation. 'medium' = the product family is under the named scheme but the specific standard was not individually confirmed. Treat 'medium' as illustrative in the demo, not as legal advice.
_meta.disclaimer: Certification obligations change with each new QCO and CRS phase notification. This is a hackathon-scope snapshot, not an authoritative compliance list.
